hints.content: Multiples are numbers that result when we multiply one whole number by another whole number.

We want to find multiples of $\greenD{12}$.

$\begin{align}
\greenD{12}\times1=12\\\\
\greenD{12}\times2=24\\\\
\greenD{12}\times3=36\\\\
\greenD{12}\times4=48\\\\
\greenD{12}\times5=60\\\\
\greenD{12}\times6=72
\end{align}$

question.content:
**Which of the following shows only multiples of $12$?**
